Class Keymap

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.Keymap
public final class Keymap extends Object
The shortcuts the user assigned, removed and reset, saved to keymap.toml in the application's config directory, and applied to every open window. A singleton.

The keymap knows a command by its owner's binary name and its id, be.imgn.swing.desktop.DocumentCommands#save, the standard commands' owner being StandardCommands: a mapping applies to that command in every view and every window. A command's effective shortcut is its mapping, none for a removed one, else the shortcut of its resources. In a window, a mapped shortcut wins over another command's shortcut from resources, which then has none there. Every method is called on the EDT.
